segments.cap: It's Thursday night, and you've got a daycare bubble show at nine tomorrow morning.
The director still needs your insurance certificate, and the invoice never went out.
Next week's school wants a signed contract by Monday.
And your helper is asking which bubble machines are going.
Here's what that same night looks like in Rally.
Every booking gets three dots. Gear, crew, and paperwork.
Your insurance certificate and contract go out with the booking, and the invoice sends itself.
Your helper gets the address, the time, and the gear list. Automatically.
Comment SATURDAY, and I'll send you the exact reminders we automate.
